## Featured event

### Merry Members

Saturday, December 5

Members at the Friend level and above are invited to share the joy and wonder of the season with the children in their lives at Merry Members. Word has it the Jolly Old Elf himself will be there!

[Register now](https://www.cartermuseum.org/events/merry-members-2026)

## Our Tiffany Windows

** 
We asked for help preserving two masterpieces of American decorative art so they would be accessible to all, forever. More than 220 donors responded. Thanks to their support you can see our newly conserved Tiffany windows at the Museum. 
**

# Asheville Art Museum - North Carolina museum exhibiting 20th century American art

[Warp, Weft, and the Grid](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/warp-weft-the-grid/)

This exhibition highlights the artistic significance of 19th- and early 20th-century southern Appalachian coverlets, exploring how the designs of these handwoven textiles anticipated many of the same visually arresting motifs at the heart of Modernist geometric abstraction in later 20th century art.

[LEARN MORE \>](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/warp-weft-the-grid/)

[The Art of Paper: Selections of Handmade Paper Works from the Collections of Jordan D. Schnitzer and His Family Foundation](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/the-art-of-paper/)

This exhibition explores the rich collaborative relationships between artists and master papermakers, revealing how the field of handmade paper art was a natural advancement of and response to the historic relationship between print and paper.

[LEARN MORE \>](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/the-art-of-paper/)

[Offset: Figurative Selections from the Sherman Print Portfolio](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/offset/)

This exhibition highlights 13 offset lithographs from an expansive portfolio of 118 produced in Jules Sherman’s de facto atelier, exploring how each artist portrayed the human form within the dialogue of Abstract Expressionism and figurative art in this period.

[LEARN MORE \>](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/offset/)

[West Coast Glass](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/west-coast-glass/)

This exhibition explores how second-generation studio glass artists shifted away from the concerns of the early studio glass movement, bringing new styles, techniques, and a collaborative spirit to the West Coast studio glass community.

[LEARN MORE \>](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/west-coast-glass/)

[On the Lathe: Shaping a Movement](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/on-the-lathe/)

This exhibition traces the development of the American studio woodturning movement through key artists who transformed the field, shifting it away from the artisanal crafting of functional forms to probe the expressive potential of wood turned by a lathe.

[LEARN MORE \>](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/on-the-lathe/)

[Support the Asheville Art Museum Annual Fund](https://fundraise.givesmart.com/form/tC5f9w?vid=19ujsb)

Donations to the Annual Fund support the Museum’s dedicated staff, our calendar of events that evolves to meet the changing needs of our community, and ensure that we remain a safe, inclusive hub for artistic exploration and dialogue in Asheville.

[SUPPORT THE MUSEUM \>](https://fundraise.givesmart.com/form/tC5f9w?vid=19ujsb)

## Current Exhibitions

[**Warp, Weft, and the Grid**\\ \\ July 17, 2026–January 17, 2027\\ \\ Warp, Weft, and the Grid highlights the artistic significance of 19th- and early 20th- southern Appalachian coverlets, exploring how the designs of these handwoven textiles anticipated many of the same visually arresting motifs at the heart of Modernist geometric abstraction in later 20th century art.](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/warp-weft-the-grid/)

[**The Art of Paper**\\ \\ June 4–November 29, 2026\\ \\ This exhibition explores the rich collaborative relationships between artists and master papermakers, revealing how the field of handmade paper art was a natural advancement of and response to the historic relationship between print and paper. Drawn exclusively from the renowned collections of Jordan D. Schnitzer and his Family Foundation, The Art of Paper features 66 works by leading artists of the 20th and 21st centuries, including Helen Frankenthaler, James Rosenquist, Frank Stella, Jasper Johns, Mark Bradford, Glenn Ligon and others who have redefined handmade paper as an expressive artistic medium.](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/the-art-of-paper/)

[**Offset**\\ \\ September 23–December 6, 2026\\ \\ This exhibition highlights 12 offset lithographs from an expansive portfolio of 118 produced in Jules Sherman’s de facto atelier, exploring how each artist portrayed the human form within the dialogue of Abstract Expressionism and figurative art in this period.](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/offset/)

[**West Coast Glass**\\ \\ July 1, 2026–Ongoing\\ \\ This exhibition explores how second-generation studio glass artists made the West Coast an epicenter for glass art by embracing new styles, techniques, and collaborations.](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/west-coast-glass/)

[**On the Lathe**\\ \\ April 29, 2026–March 21, 2027\\ \\ This exhibition traces the development of the American studio woodturning movement through key artists who transformed the field, shifting it away from the artisanal crafting of functional forms to probe the expressive potential of wood turned by a lathe.](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/on-the-lathe/)

[**Freeze Frame**\\ \\ August 12–November 15, 2026\\ \\ Freeze Frame highlights the work of legendary sports photographer Walter Iooss Jr., whose more than 60-year career has chronicled the world's most elite athletes at the top of their game. Freeze Frame reveals the quieter side of sports in photographs that capture moments of anticipation, solitude, and stillness.](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/freeze-frame-sports-photography-by-walter-iooss-jr/) 

[**Intersections in American Art**\\ \\ Ongoing\\ \\ One of two inaugural exhibitions is Intersections in American Art, the major reinstallation and reinterpretation of the Museum’s Collection in a much-enlarged gallery space.](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/intersections-in-american-art/)

[**Many Become One**\\ \\ Ongoing\\ \\ Art and artists often encourage us to consider our place in the world. Artworks in the Windgate Foundation Atrium and Museum Plaza bring many separate parts together to make a unified whole and offer a variety of possibilities for how to navigate our physical world on regional, national, and global levels.](https://www.ashevilleart.org/exhibitions/many-become-one/)

Welcome to the Art Institute of Chicago, home to a [collection of art](https://www.artic.edu/collection) that spans centuries and the globe—and one of Tripadvisor’s “Best of the Best” US attractions of 2025. We look forward to [your visit](https://www.artic.edu/visit) and invite you to explore our many [exhibitions](https://www.artic.edu/exhibitions), join one of our [free daily tours](https://www.artic.edu/events?type=6&audience=3), or make [your own tour](https://www.artic.edu/my-museum-tour) of must-see works. 

[111 S Michigan Ave](https://goo.gl/maps/rWJ5uyDiokKyETnw6)

[Buy Tickets](https://sales.artic.edu/admissions)

FOLLOW US

NOW OPEN

Mary Cassatt: After Impressionism

**Through January 3 
** 
Discover the bold and innovative work of Mary Cassatt in this gathering of over 70 experimental and ambitious works made at the height of her career. 

Tickets to this show are $7 in addition to general admission. Members never need tickets and enjoy two days of member previews and a member-only viewing hour, 10–11 a.m., every day we’re open!

[Learn more](https://www.artic.edu/exhibitions/10487/mary-cassatt-after-impressionism)

# [Winter Film Tickets on Sale Now!](https://bampfa.org/on-view/film-series)

Our Winter 2026 film season includes the continuation of our [Martin Scorsese retrospective](https://bampfa.org/program/martin-scorsese-pictures), celebrations of early Hollywood filmmaker [Ernst Lubitsch](https://bampfa.org/program/touch-lubitsch-hollywood-years) and Swedish auteur [Jan Troell](https://bampfa.org/program/everlasting-moments-cinema-jan-troell), [RoboCoup: Cinema Envisions the Future](https://bampfa.org/program/robocoup-cinema-envisions-future), a special visit from Brazilian filmmaker [Kleber Mendonça Filho](https://bampfa.org/program/kleber-mendonca-filho-person), and so much more! [Explore the season→](https://bampfa.org/film)

Want access to our member-exclusive presale and half-price film tickets? [Join as a BAMPFA member](https://bampfa.org/member) starting at just $40/year.

# See what art can do.

## What's Happening

[View Calendar](https://blantonmuseum.org/programs/)

- [Nov 15\\ \\ 2:00 PM – 3:15 PM\\ \\ **Blanton Live: The Haas Brothers**](https://blantonmuseum.org/programs/)
- [Nov 17\\ \\ 12:30 PM – 1:30 PM\\ \\ **Public Tour: Highlights of the Blanton's Collection**](https://blantonmuseum.org/programs/)
- [Nov 21\\ \\ 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM\\ \\ **UT Longhorns Home Game: Museum Open As Usual**](https://blantonmuseum.org/programs/)
- [Nov 22\\ \\ 1:30 PM – 2:30 PM\\ \\ **Visita guiada pública \[EN ESPAÑOL\] – Joyas de la colección del Blanton**](https://blantonmuseum.org/programs/)
- [Nov 22\\ \\ 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM\\ \\ **Public Tour: Highlights of the Blanton's Collection**](https://blantonmuseum.org/programs/)

[**Family Art Adventures: Sound Play**](https://blantonmuseum.org/programs/family-art-adventures/)

Make art with sound on Saturday, November 14!

Run—don’t walk—to Family Art Adventures on Nov. 14! ✨ Bring the whole crew for an afternoon filled with creativity and discovery including mindfulness activities, face painting, storytime, crafting, and more! [**Get advance tickets.**](https://blantonmuseum.org/programs/family-art-adventures/)

[**Meet the Haas Brothers on Nov. 15!**](https://blantonmuseum.org/programs/b-scene/)

Get tickets now for this exclusive in-person talk.

After the spectacular opening of [_Haas Brothers: Uncanny Valley_](https://blantonmuseum.org/exhibition/haas-brothers-uncanny-valley/)_,_ we’re excited to welcome back the Austin-raised twins for this in-person conversation. Get tickets to _Blanton Live: Conversations for Now_ with the Haas Brothers. **[Limited In-Person Tickets Available!](https://blantonmuseum.org/programs/blanton-live/)**

## On View & Upcoming

[View All Exhibitions](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/exhibitions/)

[**Haas Brothers: Uncanny Valley**](https://blantonmuseum.org/exhibition/haas-brothers-uncanny-valley/)

Now on view!

Fantastical figures land in Austin — don’t miss this major showcase of 15 years of artistic imagination.

[**The European Avant-Garde: From Impressionism to Cubism**](https://blantonmuseum.org/exhibition/the-european-avant-garde/)

Now on view!

This installation from the celebrated collection of Julian and Josie Robertson showcases major examples of the European avant-garde.

[**Shadows on Stone: Portraits of Colonial Mexican Architecture**](https://blantonmuseum.org/exhibition/shadows-on-stone/)

Now on view!

Explore captivating portraits of colonial Mexican monasteries through the lens of architectural historian John McAndrew.

[**Shaping the Future: Transformative Gifts to the Blanton Collection**](https://blantonmuseum.org/exhibition/shaping-the-future/)

Coming Mar 14, 2027

This landmark exhibition will present significant works of art donated by alumni, Austinites, and other collectors from across the country.

[**Two New Programs for Every Generation**](https://blantonmuseum.org/programs/)

We’re excited to introduce Family Art Adventures and Senior Social, two new programs to inspire a variety of audiences.

[**Read our 2025 Impact Report**](https://blantonmuseum.org/about/annual-reports/)

Our latest report celebrates completed projects and expresses gratitude to our supporters, as well as our pride to be part of The University of Texas at Austin, our deep connection to the city of Austin, and why we are seen as a leader nationally.

## Explore the Art

[Explore The Collection](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/)

[**Austin**](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/austin/) 

“Austin” is the culmination of Ellsworth Kelly’s seven-decade career and the only building he ever designed.

[Learn More about Austin by Ellsworth Kelly](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/austin/)

[**European art**](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/) 

The over 330 European paintings in the Blanton’s collection range from late 14th-century gilded panels to 19th-century landscapes.

[Learn More about Art](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/)

[**Latin American art**](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/) 

The Blanton has one of the oldest and most comprehensive collections of modern & contemporary Latin American art in the country.

[Learn More about Art](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/)

[**American art**](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/) 

The Blanton’s collection of modern & contemporary U.S. art includes works made using new or unexpected materials, such as Sonya Clark’s “Madam C. J. Walker.”

[Learn More about Art](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/)

[**Prints & Drawings**](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/) 

The Blanton’s encyclopedic collection of 18,000 works on paper features examples from all the major printmaking centers in Europe and North America.

[Learn More about Art](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/)

## Membership

**You’d make a great member!** It’s a win-win: members enjoy free admission and support the arts in our community.

[Become a Member](https://blantonmuseum.org/support/membership/?utm_source=homepage&utm_medium=homeblockmember&utm_campaign=Membership_homepage_ref)

[Blanton Directors Circle Feb 2020 1468](https://blantonmuseum.org/permanent-collection/exhibitions/)

> ### I'm a member of the Blanton because it's the heart of art in Austin. It's the great museum that we have.

Austin Kleon

[**Support the Blanton**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ynxRmm65fII)

Why becoming a member means so much.

> ### Everytime I come here it's a new experience. You're never going to see the same works of art twice.

Amaijah Summers

[25.10.25 B Scene Josh Baker 168](https://blantonmuseum.org/support/membership/)

## Learn

[Read More about University Learning](https://blantonmuseum.org/learn/university/)

University Schools Online Resources

[**University**](https://blantonmuseum.org/learn/university/)

The Blanton welcomes students from all departments, colleges, and schools on UT’s campus — as well as Austin-area colleges and universities — to explore our galleries as an extension of their classroom learning.

[**Schools**](https://blantonmuseum.org/learn/schools/)

K–12 school group visits include interactive, inquiry-based activities grounded in TEKS objectives that reinforce a variety of curricular goals. Also available in Spanish or bilingual.

[**Online Resources**](https://blantonmuseum.org/learn/resources/)

Let art come to life through interactive tours of our galleries, detailed guides, teaching materials, and creative activities inspired by the Blanton’s collection.

SUPPORT ART IN AUSTIN

Explore a selection of global modern art from the BMA’s collection online, then visit _Speaking Across Languages: Global Modernisms in the 20th Century_, the inaugural installation in the newly opened Anne and Ben Cone galleries, which brings together works across geographies and mediums to offer the BMA’s first expansive view of global modernisms. [Browse the Collection](https://artbma.org/art-by-theme/global-modernism/) [A Rich Portrait of Baltimore](https://reservations.artbma.org/orders/601/calendar?eventId=6a8da4bf67b18ab5366f2c43&cart&_gl=1*g14fui*_ga*MTQ3MTQxMjQ4LjE3NzYxOTcxNTI.*_ga_Z89PXM15R3*czE3OTQ0MjczNTQkbzQyOSRnMSR0MTc5NDQzMDczNyRqNjAkbDAkaDA.) Recognized by _The New York Times_ and _The Wall Street Journal_, [_Flashback: Two Centuries of Baltimore Photography_](https://artbma.org/exhibition/flashback-baltimore-photography/) traces photography in Baltimore from its earliest forms to unforgettable contemporary works. Described by _The Wall Street Journal_ as seeing “a city through many lenses,” the acclaimed exhibition celebrates the extraordinary artistic excellence of Baltimore and the region. [Buy Tickets Today](https://reservations.artbma.org/orders/601/calendar?eventId=6a8da4bf67b18ab5366f2c43&cart&_gl=1*g14fui*_ga*MTQ3MTQxMjQ4LjE3NzYxOTcxNTI.*_ga_Z89PXM15R3*czE3OTQ0MjczNTQkbzQyOSRnMSR0MTc5NDQzMDczNyRqNjAkbDAkaDA.) ## Welcome!

The Boise Art Museum creates visual arts experiences that engage people and inspire learning through exceptional exhibitions, collections, and educational opportunities.

## Monthly Programs

First Thursday – _Access for All!_**1st Thursday of each month | 10 a.m. – 7 p.m. 
**Admission is ‘pay what you can’ all dayBAM offers extended hours on the First Thursday of each month from 10 a.m. – 7 p.m. along with special programs including _Studio Art Exploration_. Admission and programs are by donation. 

**Studio Art Exploration**** 
Drop-in, 4:30 – 6:30 p.m.**Hands-on art making in BAM’s Education Studios. _Drop-in designed for all ages. All children must be accompanied by an adult._🗓️ Activity Calendar – Studio Art Exploration

**Make an abstract landscape painting.

_Generous support provided by Art Bridges Foundation’s Access for All program_

## [Treasures from the Family: The Gift of Betsy James Wyeth](https://www.brandywine.org/museum/blog/treasures-family-gift-betsy-james-wyeth 'Treasures from the Family: The Gift of Betsy James Wyeth')

Monday, May 4, 2026

As we dive deeply into the rich creative life of Betsy James Wyeth in the By Design exhibition this summer, a complementary exhibition in the Strawbridge Family Gallery will also uncover her role as a curator and archivist of her family collection. Opening this spring, Treasures from the Family: The Gift of Betsy James Wyeth will consist of art and archival material from the major bequest Betsy left to the Brandywine Museum of Art upon her death in 2020.

On View

# Constellations: Contemporary Jewelry from the Dallas Museum of Art

Featuring golden crowns formed to look like cardboard, enchanting necklaces made from plastic bags, and whimsical brooches resembling toast, _Constellations_ captures the depth, breadth, and diversity of contemporary jewelry design.

[Learn more](https://chrysler.org/exhibition/constellations-contemporary-jewelry-from-the-dallas-museum-of-art/ 'Learn more')

On View

# Is, Was: Glass and Metal by Christopher Wilmarth

Fifty years after the completion of Wilmarth’s glass and metal sculpture _Is, Was (Deep)_, the Chrysler Museum invites visitors to revisit this iconic work.

On View

# Define Yourself!

Developed in partnership with Historically Black Colleges and Universities across the mid-Atlantic region, _Define Yourself_ examines how Black identity has been constructed, challenged, and reclaimed through more than eighty objects from the Chrysler Museum’s collection.

[Learn more](https://chrysler.org/exhibition/define-yourself/ 'Learn more')

On View

# Arthur Jafa: Love Is the Message, The Message Is Death

Acclaimed visual artist, cinematographer, and film director Arthur Jafa (American, b. 1960) condenses the history and lived experience of Black life in the United States into a rapid, emotionally charged, seven-and-a-half-minute video montage.

[Learn more](https://chrysler.org/exhibition/arthur-jafa-love-is-the-message-the-message-is-death/ 'Learn more')

# Welcome to the Cantor Arts Center

## Now on View

## [California Current](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions/california-current-art-and-histories-bay-area)

### Art and Histories from the Bay Area

How does a community stay rooted in a region that’s constantly changing? _California Current_ invites you to consider this question and others through its more than 60 works — many on view for the first time — that explore the interplay between Bay Area history, art, and artists over the past century.

[Explore](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions/california-current-art-and-histories-bay-area)

 [Binh Danh (American, born in Vietnam, 1977). Lower Yosemite Fall, 2014. Daguerreotype. 11 1/4 x 9 1/4 in. Cantor Arts Center, Stanford University, The Anonymous B Acquisition Fund, 2021.141. © Binh Danh • Bernice Bing (American, 1936–1998). Blue Mountain No. 4, 1966. Oil and acrylic on canvas, 75 x 68 1/8 in. Cantor Arts Center, Stanford University gift of Alexa Young. Funding for the conservation of this artwork was generously provided through a grant from the Bank of America Art Conservation Project, 2020](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions/california-current-art-and-histories-bay-area)

## [Solid Pictures](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions/solid-pictures)

### Photosculpture and the Making of Modern Likeness

Before 3D printing, there was photosculpture. Curated by Patrick R. Crowley, Associate Curator of European Art, _Solid Pictures_ is the first major exhibition to explore these largely overlooked objects first conceived in 1859 by the twenty-nine-year-old French artist and inventor François Willème.

[Explore](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions/solid-pictures)

 [Oliver Laric, Self-Portrait](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions/solid-pictures)

## [JANE!](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions/jane)

Bringing together precious keepsakes, souvenirs, archaeological detritus, and spooky messages from beyond the grave, the exhibition reveals the campy underside of a familiar biography and perhaps an even more familiar murder mystery.

[Explore](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions/jane)

 [Jane Stanford Portrait](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions/jane)

## [Carolyn Lazard: Long Take](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions/carolyn-lazard-long-take)

A multimedia exhibition that begins with a score for a performance and unfolds as a series of interventions that engage accessibility as an artistic material.

[Explore](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions/carolyn-lazard-long-take)

 [Carolyn Lazard, Leans, Reverses, Three-channel video, sound. Courtesy of the artist and Trautwein Herleth](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions/carolyn-lazard-long-take)

## [Archive Rooms](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions#archive-rooms)

The dual presentation of Irene Poon and Charles Wong sheds new light on each artist’s practice. The Mesa-Bains _Archive Room_ presentation further contextualizes the artist, curator, and educator’s role in shaping Chicano and Latino art history over the past half century.

[Explore](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions#archive-rooms)

 [Page from Amalia Mesa-Bains, Curandera's Botanica binder](https://museum.stanford.edu/exhibitions#archive-rooms)

Through our outstanding [**collection**](https://www.columbusmuseum.org/collection), [**exhibitions**](https://www.columbusmuseum.org/exhibitions), and [**programs**](https://www.columbusmuseum.org/events), we seek to provide **great experiences with great art for everyone**. Founded in 1878, Columbus Museum of Art has long been a space for dialogue, connection, and transformative experiences with art. Visit us at our main location in the heart of **Downtown Columbus** or our campus in the **Short North Arts District**.

## Refresh, recharge, and reconnect with joy

Clyfford Still Museum Shop, photo by Brent Andeck

## The Legacy of 
Clyfford Still

Renegade artist Clyfford Still redefined American painting. He wanted people to make their own interpretations of his work and refused to compromise his artistic vision for fame, recognition, or financial success. Still entrusted his life’s work to an American city, and the Clyfford Still Museum embodies this exceptional act of generosity.

**Explore your creativity and be inspired by immersive artworks. Celebrate the Still’s 15th anniversary with never-before-seen paintings.**

### The Museum allows visitors the unique 
experience to understand the artist Clyfford Still

Home to the art and legacy of the American painter Clyfford Still, we invite all to explore the potential of individual creative endeavor. Designed specifically to display Clyfford Still’s art, the award-winning Museum is home to nearly everything the artist created, approximately 3,125 pieces representing 93% of his lifetime of work. The Museum supports new artistic endeavors, inviting visitors to draw strength from Still’s art and life. Refresh, recharge, and reconnect with joy at the Clyfford Still Museum.

At the Still, visitors will find a world-class collection gifted to the City and County of Denver, award-winning architecture, cross-disciplinary events for all ages, and opportunities for visitors to explore their own creativity. Exhibitions stimulate curiosity and explore multiple perspectives. You are free to experience and understand the art on your own terms; there are no wrong answers at the Still. Discover the best way to spend an hour in Denver at this unique art museum.

[****An Exquisite Eye: Introducing the Aso O. Tavitian Collection****\\ \\ **Open through February 21, 2027**\\ \\ Presenting a look at the exceptional gift of Aso O. Tavitian’s collection, showcasing European masterpieces, debuting publicly ahead of the new Tavitian Wing opening.\\ \\ More](https://www.clarkart.edu/Microsites/An-Exquisite-Eye/About-the-Exhibition)

[****Sónia Almeida: Stages****\\ \\ **Open through January 23, 2028**\\ \\ Sónia Almeida will present three site-responsive installations for this exhibition in public spaces at the Clark.\\ \\ More](https://www.clarkart.edu/exhibition/detail/sonia-almeida-stages)

[****In Addition: Extra-Illustrated, Annotated, and Otherwise Altered Books****\\ \\ **OPENING SEPTEMBER 25, 2026**\\ \\ Explore how unusual features make their way into volumes, whether part of a planned design or the spontaneous expression of a book’s owner.\\ \\ More](https://www.clarkart.edu/exhibition/detail/in-addition-extra-illustrated,-annotated,-and-othe)

[****Permanent Collection****\\ \\ Revisit an old favorite or discover something new in our permanent collection.\\ \\ More](https://www.clarkart.edu/Museum/Collections/Browse-Collections)

There’s so much to see at the Clark! Our collection spans centuries, artists, and ideas, with familiar favorites and unexpected discoveries around every corner.

As we prepare for construction of our new Aso O. Tavitian Wing, some galleries will temporarily close. There’s still much to explore throughout the museum, and we can’t wait to welcome you.

Planning to visit for a particular work? Check [our online collection](https://www.clarkart.edu/museum/collections/browse-collections) to confirm that it’s currently on view. Questions about your visit? Contact us at [info@clarkart.edu](mailto:info@clarkart.edu) or call us at 413 458 2303.

 [**Clark Prize Lecture**\\ \\ **November 15**\\ \\ Georgina Kleege, the recipient of the 2026 Clark Prize for Excellence in Arts Writing, has built a career championing accessibility and inclusive approaches to art.\\ \\ More](https://events.clarkart.edu/detail/5442)

# The Cummer Museum

The Cummer Museum was established in 1958 when Ninah Cummer, an avid art collector, garden enthusiast, and civic leader, bequeathed her beloved art collection and riverfront home to create a museum. Today, the core collection of 60 pieces from Mrs. Cummer’s estate has grown to include more than 5,000 works of art. The historically significant gardens, set against the backdrop of the St. Johns River, serve as a centerpiece of serenity for all to enjoy. We encourage you to reap the benefits of [**becoming a member**](https://www.cummermuseum.org/admission-membership#membership) of The Cummer Museum. Whether you’re a member or visitor, _you’ll fit right in!_

The Museum is open today 12 to 4 p.m.

## [Sapphire Soirée: 65 Years of Art & Elegance](https://www.cummermuseum.org/sapphire-soiree/)

Saturday, November 7, 2026 | 5:30 to 10:30 p.m.

Join us for a black-tie gala celebrating the Cummer Museum of Art & Gardens’ 65th anniversary. Set against the beauty of the Museum’s historic riverfront gardens, this special evening will honor 65 years of art, gardens, learning, and community impact.

[**Purchase Tickets**](https://www.cummermuseum.org/sapphire-soiree/) [**Sponsorship Opportunities**](https://www.cummermuseum.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Sapphire-Soiree_Sponsor-packet_FINAL.pdf)

## Mission & Vision

The Cummer Museum of Art & Gardens is an essential part of the creative and cultural fabric of Northeast Florida and beyond. The unparalleled experiences we create honor Ninah Cummer’s legacy, enhance the quality of life for everyone, and cement the Cummer Museum’s position as a social hub that ignites surprise and fun.

Located on the banks of the St. Johns River in Jacksonville, Florida, the Cummer Museum is a beacon of resilience and a committed steward of its natural environment.

Our passion for showcasing art and living collections through high-impact public programs in a welcoming setting inspires visitors to incorporate the Cummer Museum into their lives. Our commitment, creativity, and dynamism make the Cummer Museum a cultural leader that will positively impact current and future generations.

It is our mission to create art, garden, and learning experiences that spark discovery and well-being.

metadata.title: Home | Currier Museum of Art
metadata.description: The Currier Museum of Art is an art museum located in Manchester, New Hampshire, United States. Its permanent collection includes significant works by artists like Picasso, Matisse, Monet, O'Keeffe, Calder, John Singer Sargent, and Andrew Wyeth, among many others. The Currier owns and operates two house museums designed by the renowned architect Frank Lloyd Wright: the Zimmerman House and the Toufic H. Kalil House. The collection boasts over 15,000 objects, spanning various periods and mediums.

## **Discover the Dalí Museum** 
**in St. Petersburg, Florida**

[Plan your visit](https://thedali.org/visit/) and view an unparalleled collection of works by renowned artist Salvador Dalí, from iconic melting clocks to imaginative visual illusions and avant-garde symbols. Shop, play, wander and quench your curiosity for all that is Salvador Dalí and beyond.

[**Dalí: Disruption + Devotion, On View**\\ \\ Co-organized by The Dalí Museum and the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, this special exhibition explores Salvador Dalí’s artistic dialogue with earlier European painters. Pairing works across centuries, it reveals how Dalí revered and reworked the traditions he inherited to shape his own artistic vision.](https://thedali.org/exhibit/dali-disruption-and-devotion/)

[**Support The Dalí**\\ \\ Your gift to the Annual Fund supports exhibitions, education and art preservation, helping us share Salvador Dalí’s legacy with our community and beyond.](https://thedali.org/give/annual-fund/)

[**Surreal Nature in The Dalí Dome, Closes Dec 7**\\ \\ Now in The Dalí Dome is _Surreal Nature_, a first-of-its-kind collaboration between The Dalí and Arte Museum that transforms the natural world into a fantastical dreamscape of light, movement and sound, where nature unfolds in unexpected and extraordinary ways.](https://thedali.org/surreal-nature/)

[**The Architecture of The Dalí, On View**\\ \\ Discover the design story behind The Dalí Museum, from its early days to its world-renowned galleries. Explore archival photos, models and a preview of the upcoming expansion in this special exhibition.](https://thedali.org/exhibit/the-architecture-of-the-dali/)

[**Dalí Alive 360°, On View**\\ \\ Step into the mesmerizing world of Salvador Dalí as art comes to life like never before. This multisensory art experience envelops visitors in 360 degrees of light and sound within The Dali Dome, playing daily starting at 10:30am.](https://thedali.org/exhibit/dali-alive-360/)

[**calendar of events**\\ \\ The Museum hosts a variety of programs, including performances, educational lectures and more. See our calendar of events.](https://thedali.org/events/category/featured/)

### [Support the Dalí](https://thedali.org/give/)

The Dalí Museum is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. Gifts to The Dalí directly support our mission to preserve Salvador Dalí’s work and legacy. [Learn more.](https://thedali.org/give/#main)

# Exhibitions

Exhibitions

Explore the Colby Museum’s exhibitions: current, upcoming, and past as well as traveling shows on view at other venues.

## Current Exhibitions

Current Exhibitions

Previous SlideNext Slide

- ## [The Sun Never Sets: Photographs and Prints of Cuba, the Philippines, and Puerto Rico from The Hispanic Society Museum and Library\\ \\ The Sun Never Sets: Photographs and Prints of Cuba, the Philippines, and Puerto Rico from The Hispanic Society Museum and Library](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/the-sun-never-sets)

 November 5, 2026–April 18, 2027

 [Exhibition Details](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/the-sun-never-sets)

 [The Sun Never Sets: Photographs and Prints of Cuba, the Philippines, and Puerto Rico from The Hispanic Society Museum and Library](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/the-sun-never-sets)

 Explore rare photographs, prints, and albums depicting Cuba, the Philippines, and Puerto Rico under Spanish colonial rule, including many never before exhibited.

- ## [Why Look at Horses?\\ \\ Why Look at Horses?](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/why-look-at-horses)

 September 17, 2026–March 14, 2027

 [Exhibition Details](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/why-look-at-horses)

 [Why Look at Horses?](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/why-look-at-horses)

 An exploration of what remains of our relationship to horses—captured across photographs, drawings, prints, and video from the nineteenth century to today.

- ## [Imagining an Archipelago: Art from Cuba, Guam, the Philippines, Puerto Rico, and Their Diasporas\\ \\ Imagining an Archipelago: Art from Cuba, Guam, the Philippines, Puerto Rico, and Their Diasporas](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/imagining-an-archipelago)

 July 11, 2026–June 6, 2027

 [Exhibition Details](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/imagining-an-archipelago)

 [Imagining an Archipelago: Art from Cuba, Guam, the Philippines, Puerto Rico, and Their Diasporas](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/imagining-an-archipelago)

 Featuring approximately fifty contemporary and vibrant artworks connecting the histories of Cuba, Guam, the Philippines, Puerto Rico, and their diasporas.

- ## [Alex Katz: Quick Things Passing\\ \\ Alex Katz: Quick Things Passing](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/quick-things-passing-the-alex-katz-collection)

 March 12, 2026–December 31, 2029

 [Exhibition Details](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/quick-things-passing-the-alex-katz-collection)

 [Alex Katz: Quick Things Passing](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/quick-things-passing-the-alex-katz-collection)

 A career-spanning selection of paintings, prints, drawings, and sculptures reflecting Alex Katz’s enduring attention to the ever-shifting qualities of the people and landscapes around him.

- ## [Some American Stories\\ \\ Some American Stories](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/some-american-stories)

 September 26, 2024–December 31, 2027

 [Exhibition Details](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/some-american-stories)

 [Some American Stories](https://museum.colby.edu/exhibitions/some-american-stories)

# Welcome to the Denver Art Museum

Today is November 15. We are open 10 am – 5 pm.

## What's on View

 [Now On View\\ \\ DIVA](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/exhibitions/diva)

 [Now On View\\ \\ Storytellers\\ \\ The Blackfeet Nation and Charles M. Russell](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/exhibitions/storytellers)

 [Now On View\\ \\ John E. Thompson and Colorado Modernism](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/exhibitions/john-edward-thompson)

 [Now On View\\ \\ Knife Fork Spoon\\ \\ Everyday Tools, Extraordinary Design](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/exhibitions/knife-fork-spoon)

 [Now On View\\ \\ Space Is the Place\\ \\ Art & Design in the Atomic Age](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/exhibitions/space-place)

## Upcoming Events

Dive deeper into art and join us for one of these upcoming events or programs.

[View Calendar](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar)

 [October 26-November 11, 2026\\ \\ **Momentos de Memoria**\\ \\ Celebrate Día de Muertos with a museumwide activation.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/momentos-de-memoria)

 [Occurs monthly on Tuesday. Next is Nov 17, 2026\\ \\ **Mindful Looking**\\ \\ Mindful Looking invites you to slow down and spend time with a single work of art.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/mindful-looking)

 [November 17, 2026 - 3 pm and 6:30 pm\\ \\ **Behind the Baton LIVE: DIVA, The Sound of Style**\\ \\ Join CPR Classical and the DAM for a special edition of Behind the Baton LIVE, inspired by DIVA.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/behind-baton-live-diva)

 [Occurs monthly on Thursday. Next is Nov 19, 2026\\ \\ **Create & Play**\\ \\ Create & Play is an early-childhood program offering a range of activities and interactive experiences for the whole family.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/create-play)

 [Nov 21, 2026\\ \\ **Macheté Mouth Record Release and Concert at the Denver Art Museum**](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/machete-mouth-record-release)

 [Nov 21, 2026\\ \\ **Live Printing with Lily at Macheté Mouth Record Release**](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/machete-mouth-live-printing-lily)

 [Occurs monthly on Tuesday. Next is Dec 1, 2026\\ \\ **Drop-In Drawing with Anna Kaye**\\ \\ Immerse yourself in the art-filled atmosphere of our museum with an in-person drawing session with artist Anna Kaye.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/drop-in-drawing)

 [Dec 1, 2026\\ \\ **DIVA After Dark with Genevieve Libien**\\ \\ DIVA After Dark features live entertainment, a pop-up bar, and a photo op designed for your moment in the spotlight.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/diva-after-dark-genevieve-libien)

 [December 4-6, 2026\\ \\ **Member Holiday Shopping Sale**\\ \\ Kick off the holiday season with the Denver Art Museum's annual shopping event!](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/member-holiday-shopping-sale)

 [Dec 5, 2026\\ \\ ****Live Printing with Lily at DIVA****\\ \\ Release your inner diva with a custom-printed new t-shirt you can be sure no one else will be wearing!](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/diva-live-printing-lily)

 [Dec 8, 2026\\ \\ **SCFD Free Day**\\ \\ Enjoy free general admission at the DAM thanks to the residents who support SCFD.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/free-day-dec-8-2026)

 [Dec 8, 2026\\ \\ **Drop-In Drawing with Anna Kaye (Online)**\\ \\ Dive into the world of art from the comfort of your home with these quarterly online drawing sessions with Anna Kaye.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/drop-drawing-online)

 [Dec 8, 2026\\ \\ **Anderman Photography Lecture: Conversation with Patricia Lagarde**](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/anderman-photography-lecture-patricia-lagarde)

 [Occurs monthly on Thursday. Next is Dec 10, 2026\\ \\ **Art & About**\\ \\ Designed for visitors with early-stage Alzheimer's or dementia and their care partners, experience art while led by a specially trained guide.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/art-about)

 [Occurs weekly on Saturday for 4 times. Next is Dec 19, 2026\\ \\ **Demo Artist: Katie Wells**\\ \\ Join artist Katie Wells for Studio Saturdays in the Cosmic Studio.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/demo-artist-katie-wells)

 [Jan 5, 2027\\ \\ **DIVA After Dark with Opera Colorado**\\ \\ DIVA After Dark features live entertainment, a pop-up bar, and a photo op designed for your moment in the spotlight.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/diva-after-dark-opera-colorado)

 [Jan 10, 2027\\ \\ **Sensory-Friendly Morning**\\ \\ A program for guests of all ages with neurodiversity or sensory processing disorders to visit the museum in a safe and fun way.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/sensory-friendly-morning)

 [Jan 12, 2027\\ \\ **SCFD Free Day**\\ \\ Engage with art, experience onsite activities, and explore the art on view all while enjoying free general admission!](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar/scfd-free-day-january)

## Stories from the DAM

Catch up on the latest news and stories from the Denver Art Museum blog.

[View blog](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/blogs)

 [**DIVA is 'part fashion exhibition, part music history lesson, part celebrity time machine'**](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/blog/diva-part-fashion-exhibition-part-music-history-lesson)

 [**Iconic Mexican Actress María Félix Featured in DIVA**\\ \\ See the famous costume she wore for the leading role in the 1943 film, _Doña Bárbara_, which is how she became known as “La Doña."](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/blog/iconic-mexican-actress-maria-felix-featured-diva)

 [**Momentos de Memoria Turns the DAM Into an _Ofrenda_**\\ \\ In honor of the Day of the Dead, place colorful paper skulls next to artworks that remind you of someone or something you’ve lost.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/blog/momentos-de-memoria-turns-dam-ofrenda)

 [**Get Ready for the SpooKiKi Ball at Untitled: Artist Takeover**\\ \\ Join us for a DIVA-inspired evening celebrating the art of Ballroom culture.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/blog/get-ready-spookiki-ball-untitled-artist-takeover)

 [**What to See and Do at the Denver Art Museum - Fall 2026 Guide**\\ \\ Five ways to have a fun, fascinating, and fashionable fall at the DAM.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/blog/what-see-and-do-denver-art-museum-fall-2026-guide)

 [**Fall 2026 Guide to Family Fun at the Denver Art Museum**\\ \\ If you’re looking for a fun, educational outing for the whole family, the DAM has you covered!](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/blog/fall-2026-guide-family-fun-denver-art-museum)

 [****Celebrating Five Years of** _**Indomitably Indigenous**_**\\ \\ The Youth Community Showcase series featuring the artworks of young local Indigenous artists celebrates its fifth anniversary this fall.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/blog/celebrating-five-years-indomitably-indigenous)

 [**20 Courageous, Visionary, and Fabulous Quotes by Icons in DIVA**\\ \\ Legendary words from legendary performers. DIVA opens October 4, 2026.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/blog/20-courageous-visionary-and-fabulous-quotes-by-icons-diva)

 [**Set the Table for Summer with _Knife Fork Spoon_**\\ \\ A spotlight on flatware related to summer themes.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/blog/set-table-summer-knife-fork-spoon)

 [**Explore Colorado Art in the Galleries**\\ \\ As this year's Colorado Day marks 150 years of statehood, explore art in the Denver Art Museum's collection made in and inspired by Colorado.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/blog/explore-colorado-art-galleries)

 [**_Cloud World_ by Maynard Dixon**\\ \\ American artist Maynard Dixon depicts the vast spaces and minute details of desert landscapes through rich color and thoughtful framing.](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/blog/cloud-world-by-maynard-dixon)

## Creative Classes

Connect with professional creatives, learn a new skill, and expand your own creative practice by taking a [Creative Class](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/creative-classes) at the museum. Choose from [painting](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/painting-classes), [drawing](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/drawing-classes), [mixed-media](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/mixed-media-classes), and [textile](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/textile-classes) classes that span either 1 or 2 days, 4 weeks, or 6 weeks.

## Discover More as a Member

Membership unlocks access to more than ever before! As a member you'll enjoy daily free general admission, discounts at the Shop and on ticketed exhibitions, guest passes to share with family and friends, a subscription to our bimonthly member magazine, and so much more.

Become a member today and know that your support helps your Denver Art Museum preserve and share our collection for all to enjoy.

[Learn more](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/membership)

 [Young girl painting while wearing a Free for Kids sticker](https://d26jxt5097u8sr.cloudfront.net/s3fs-public/2026-08/Young-girl-painting-free-for-kids.jpg)

## Free for Kids

All visitors 18 and under enjoy free general admission to the museum every day, thanks to the [Free for Kids](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/free-kids) program presented by Bellco Credit Union. Explore our online calendar and our family programs to help map out your fun on your next visit.

[View Calendar](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/calendar) [View Family Programs](https://www.denverartmuseum.org/en/family-programs)

 [Fall menu at The Ponti feautring a chicken sandwich and fries](https://d26jxt5097u8sr.cloudfront.net/s3fs-public/2025-12/Ponti-fall-2025-menu.jpg)

## Eat at The Ponti

The Ponti, located in the Sie Welcome Center of the Martin Building, combines art with dining to present a locally-sourced and seasonally-inspired menu. Come for lunch on weekdays, brunch on the weekends, and dinner on Tuesday and Friday nights. A museum ticket is not required to dine at The Ponti.

Follow The Ponti's Instagram account ([@thepontidenver](https://www.instagram.com/thepontidenver/)) for information about giveaways, new additions to the menu, and more.

[Learn more](https://www.thepontidenver.com/)

 [Woman talking to retail associate at the DAM's Shop](https://d26jxt5097u8sr.cloudfront.net/s3fs-public/2026-08/Visitor-at-the-Shop-2026.jpg)

## Stop by the Shops

Bring a piece of the museum home with you! Stop by the shops during regular museum hours or shop online now to find unique art-inspired products, including jewelry, home goods, books, art activities, and many other delightfully creative gifts.

Sign up for our shops email newsletter to stay in the know about sales and new merch! Nonmembers will receive a welcome with 10% off your first online order. Members will receive a welcome with 20% off your first online order. [Sign up today](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fshop.denverartmuseum.org%2Fpages%2Fsubscribe&data=05%7C02%7Ccbrice%40denverartmuseum.org%7Cd74f003adf1c48303cc408dd923bcde6%7Cce07caf59ef14a37b466a44073737e5f%7C0%7C0%7C638827507748274059%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Rnea%2FoqsXJSSSMDfMBFuYkUzXCyoi%2Fxb82UVt57Tqj0%3D&reserved=0).

Spectacular Quilts from the American Folk Art Museum_**\\ \\ October 17, 2026 — January 10, 2027\\ \\ Explore the rich history and visual impact of American quilts from the 1800s to today.](https://www.daytonartinstitute.org/do-see/exhibitions/2026/10/17/wall-power-spectacular-quilts-from-the-american-folk-art-museum) [**_Captivating Clay: Contemporary Japanese Ceramics from the Horvitz Collection_**\\ \\ April 13, 2024 — January 03, 2027\\ \\ Today, Japanese ceramic artists are building on centuries of tradition and taking the art in dynamic and new directions.](https://www.daytonartinstitute.org/do-see/exhibitions/2024/04/13/captivating-clay-contemporary-japanese-ceramics-from-the-horvitz-collection) [**_Exploring Feminism_**\\ \\ February 07, 2026 — January 31, 2027\\ \\ When you hear the word "Feminism" what is your gut reaction? A Dayton tradition established in 1971, DAI’s Oktoberfest is southwest Ohio’s longest-running Oktoberfest celebration and the museum’s largest annual fundraiser.

[Event Details](https://www.daytonartinstitute.org/do-see/calendar/2027/09/25/oktoberfest-2027-saturday)

## Explore 5,000 years of art through the DAI's permanent collection.

The DAI’s encyclopedic collection spans 5,000 years and more than 28,000 objects, with approximately 1,000 rotating works on view, offering a fresh experience with every visit.

Search the Collection

_Watchtower_

Artist(s) unknown (China, Eastern Han dynasty, 25–220 CE), Watchtower, 2nd century CE, earthenware with green glaze, 44 1/2 x 13 1/2 x 16 inches (113 x 34.3 x 40.6 cm). Museum purchase in memory of Kathleen (Kit) Johnston and in recognition of the many DAI volunteers she epitomized, 1992.18

[Learn More](https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/1049/watchtower?ctx=bba842f41d9a3434bd5c6237c8c0d9d409e0d9ad&idx=0)

_Vendedoras de Frutas_

Alfredo Ramos Martínez (Mexican, 1871–1946), Vendedoras de Frutas, about 1937, oil on canvas, 46 1/4 x 36 inches (117.5 x 91.4 cm). Gift of the Honorable Jefferson Patterson, 1959.3

[Learn More](https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/2501/vendedoras-de-frutas?ctx=2584cd4556457f11b5f9349401b3e864c4d3b602&idx=0)

_Lost and Found_

Alison Saar (American, born 1956), Lost and Found, 2003, wood, tin, wire, 28 1/2 x 125 x 33 inches (72.4 x 317.5 x 83.8 cm). Museum purchase with funds provided by the 2004 Medici Society, 2004.16

[Learn More](https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/13823/lost-and-found?ctx=1957b4a6f2c6bfa9960ae85273e600744e29b191&idx=1)

_Shark Girl as Boxer_

Casey Riordan Millard (American, born 1973), Shark Girl as Boxer, 2016, mixed media, 78 x 32 x 32 inches (198.1 x 81.3 x 81.3 cm). Gift of Sara M. and Michelle Vance Waddell, 2026.26

[Learn More](https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/29776/shark-girl-as-boxer?ctx=d6afe21ab28eca7cad99cfb1a7c8be660d1bbd93&idx=0)

_Relief with Design of Dragons_

Artist(s) unknown (China, Shanxi province, Ming dynasty, 1368–1644), Reliefs with Design of Dragons, late 14th – early 15th century, marble, 50 1/2 x 90 x 4 1/2 inches (128.3 x 228.6 x 11.4 cm).

[Learn More](https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/876/relief-with-design-of-dragons?ctx=9c2be88a84731862dc0e0850e9d3c6d7b95a2187&idx=10)

_Nymphéas_

Claude Monet (French, 1840 – 1926), Nymphéas (Waterlilies), 1903, oil on canvas, 32 x 40 inches (81.3 x 101.6 cm). Gift of Mr. Joseph Rubin, 1953.11

[Learn More](https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/350/nympheas?ctx=a79beb5e0577560f166cb0c127873ccbdfc0fa72&idx=1)

_The Seventies Groove_

Don “DonCee” Coulter (American, born 1970), The Seventies Groove, 2020, leather, suede, denim, synthetic hair, wood, various fabrics, 35 3/4 x 48 inches (89.5 x 121.9 cm). Museum purchase, 2022.3

[Learn More](https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/24948/the-seventies-groove?ctx=fb1f2634ff486c08596c0062dd5acb84cc1c8774&idx=14)

_High Noon_

Edward Hopper (American, 1883–1966),High Noon, 1949, oil on canvas, 27 1/2 x 39 1/2 inches (69.9 x100.3 cm). Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Anthony Haswell, 1971.7

[Learn More](https://https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/28/high-noon?ctx=e38ee7b8649e654ebc38dc22d37136ab52d3c82c&idx=0)

_Flowers Number 6_

Florine Stettheimer (American, 1871–1944), Flowers Number 6, around 1915, oil on canvas, 30 x 36 inches (76.2 x 91.4 cm). Gift of the Estate of Ettie Stettheimer, 1965.133

[Learn More](https://https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/178/flowers-number-6?ctx=b0539ce00741c3745019f4ac465983de724b0f5f&idx=0)

_Le Dîner au Casino_

Gaston La Touche (French, 1854–1913), Le Dîner au Casino (Dinner at the Casino), about 1906, oil on canvas 39 x 37 5/8 inches (99.1 x 95.6 cm). Gift of Mrs. Robert Schermer, 1975.33

[Learn More](https://https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/231/le-diner-au-casino?ctx=841492c8c37d97efaf013d225296c659b341d4a6&idx=0)

_Purple Leaves_

Georgia O'Keeffe (American, 1887–1986), Purple Leaves, 1922, oil on canvas mounted on board, 9 x 12 x 3/8 inches (22.9 x 30.5 cm). Bequest of Virginia Rike Haswell, 1977.60

[Learn More](https://https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/1379/purple-leaves?ctx=aa54fb464d227590c69a95d9afe7adb65643a3f6&idx=3)

_Kannon Bosatsu_

Artist(s) unknown (Japan, Muromachi period, 1333–1568), Kannon Bosatsu, 15th–16th century, wood with lacquer, gilding, pigments, copper, crystal and beads, 17 1/2 x 13 inches (44.5 x 33 cm). Museum purchase with funds provided by Virginia Rike Haswell, 1979.49

[Learn More](https://https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/1162/kannon-bosatsu?ctx=a1ec7798c495e0e9dd0f954e65f350b0bd67e8ff&idx=0)

_Love Force_

James Pate (American), Love Force, 2024, scratch boards, 66 x 84 inches (167.6 x 213.4 cm). Museum purchase, 2024.19

[Learn More](https://https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/28969/love-force?ctx=5d7a7ad8d30c119e58dba26275eeb72f7f3f2009&idx=0)

_Homage to the Square: Sentinel_

Josef Albers (American, born in Germany, 1888–1976), Homage to the Square: Sentinel, 1968, oil on canvas mounted on Masonite, 48 x 48 inches (121.9 x 121.9 cm). Gift of Society Bank, 1986.15

[Learn More](https://https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/161/homage-to-the-square-sentinel?ctx=696fbafa2f31747405e24de9afcfa79ed858a3f0&idx=2)

_The Honourable Augustus Keppel, Admiral of the Blue II_

Kehinde Wiley (American, born 1977), The Honourable Augustus Keppel, Admiral of the Blue II, 2006, oil on canvas, frame: 82 1/4 x 70 1/4 inches 71 x 60 inches (180.3 x 152.4 cm). Museum purchase with funds from James F. Dicke Family, Associate Board Art Ball Proceeds, Margie Mack Yowell Fund, 2026.28

[Learn More](https://https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/18421/the-honourable-augustus-keppel-admiral-of-the-blue-ii?ctx=2fe1a436336c7ca2f00b322432d19915bdcb4241)

_Kuosi (Elephant Mask) Society Costume_

Artist(s) unknown (Cameroon, Bamileke people), Kuosi (Elephant Mask) Society Costume, 19th and 20th century, fabric, fur, hair, beads, ivory, feathers, twine, height 67 inches (170.2cm). Museum purchase with funds provided by Dianne Komminsk, 1999.76

[Learn More](https://https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/886/kuosi-elephant-mask-society-costume?ctx=44db845f7e63329337b8fa904009a88f34e085ed&idx=0)

_Study Heads of an Old Man_

Sir Peter Paul Rubens (Flemish, 1577–1641), Study Heads of an Old Man, about 1612, oil on oak panel, 26 1/2 x 19 3/4 inches (67.3 x 50.2 cm). Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Carlton W. Smith, 1960.82

[Learn More](https://https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/700/study-heads-of-an-old-man?ctx=630da50a52e427c76d965daaa976f40c1da2f04d&idx=0)

_Amphora_

The Dayton Painter (Greek, Archaic period), Amphora, about 520 BCE, terra cotta with black-figure decoration, 13 x 8 1/2 x 8 1/2 inches (33 x 21.6 x 21.6 cm). Museum purchase, 1963.84

[Learn More](https://https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/348/amphora?ctx=9344812d5be599f223e5eb30727a848f4992d319&idx=0)

_Fleeing Chaos_

Toots Zynsky (American, born 1951), Fleeing Chaos, 1996, fused glass threads, 12 1/2 x 21 3/4 x 13 3/4 inches (31.8 x 55.2 x 34.9 cm). Museum purchase with funds from the James F. Dicke Family, 1999.60

[Learn More](https://https://daytonart.emuseum.com/objects/1097/fleeing-chaos?ctx=883ab5e0c9ea3b903297e117e904f1b742086042&idx=0)

# Welcome!

The Des Moines Art Center is a museum, [art school](https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdesmoinesartcenter.org%2Fclasses%2F&data=05%7C02%7C%7C643cf93cdc3f404d716608dd37443efc%7Ca6f4adc53a8d458b8107412a39c8c7fb%7C0%7C0%7C638727488450360793%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=XS5YgSoDYZs8tGDo9Q2VPVDOQp7briSrnZNTAFDqz%2Fk%3D&reserved=0), and [sculpture park](https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdesmoinesartcenter.org%2Fvisit%2Fpappajohn-sculpture-park%2F&data=05%7C02%7C%7C643cf93cdc3f404d716608dd37443efc%7Ca6f4adc53a8d458b8107412a39c8c7fb%7C0%7C0%7C638727488450377809%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=oF1bOtsRxQ%2BAWm7SUGQG6GqZrO1%2Fxk6s295le%2BgBQvU%3D&reserved=0) open to all.  Admission is always free.

[PLAN YOUR VISIT](https://desmoinesartcenter.org/visit/)

Let Us Gather in a Flourishing Way

##### Current Exhibition

### Let Us Gather in a Flourishing Way

#### Contemporary Latinx Painting

October 24, 2026 - January 24, 2027

[Explore Exhibition](https://desmoinesartcenter.org/art/exhibitions/let-us-gather-in-a-flourishing-way/)

##### Explore The Park

## Pappajohn Sculpture Park

The John and Mary Pappajohn Sculpture Park is an urban oasis in the heart of Des Moines that features monumental sculptures by some of the world’s most celebrated artists.

[Plan your visit](https://desmoinesartcenter.org/visit/pappajohn-sculpture-park/)

Contribute to the [Friends of the Pappajohn Sculpture Park Campaign](https://desmoinesartcenter.org/pappajohn-sculpture-park-campaign/) to help improve accessibility and maintain the beloved park for years to come.

##### Register now

## Art School Classes

The Art Center’s Art School provides youth, teen, and adult studio art classes catered to all skill levels, from beginner to advanced. Classes are taught by local, practicing teaching artists who have a background and passion for art education.

[Learn more and view class list](https://desmoinesartcenter.org/classes/)

## Upcoming Events

[See All Upcoming Events](https://desmoinesartcenter.org/calendar/)

[Nov 17\\ \\ 12:00 pm\\ \\ **Creative Aging: Gallery Series (Ages 55+)**\\ \\ Des Moines Art Center 4700 Grand Ave, Des Moines, IA\\ \\ Learn More](https://desmoinesartcenter.org/event/creative-aging-2/)

[Nov 19\\ \\ 2:00 pm\\ \\ **Creative Aging: Studio Series (Ages 55+) – SOLD OUT**\\ \\ Des Moines Art Center 4700 Grand Ave, Des Moines, IA\\ \\ Learn More](https://desmoinesartcenter.org/event/creative-aging-studio-series-ages-55/)

##### Every voice belongs in art

## Get Involved

Provide your community with free access to the arts by supporting the Des Moines Art Center through membership or charitable giving. Enjoy exclusive benefits, deepen your connection with the arts, and inspire others by supporting free admission, every day for everyone.

[Become a member](https://desmoinesartcenter.org/support/membership/)

[Give Today](https://desmoinesartcenter.org/support/give/)

##### Museum at Home

## Virtual Tours

Explore unique architecture and captivating exhibits with our virtual tour experience.

[see all virtual tours](https://desmoinesartcenter.org/visit/tours/virtual/)

## Beauty Inside and Out

Dixon Gallery and Gardens is an art museum and public garden located in the heart of Memphis, Tennessee. Featuring rotating art exhibitions, a renowned permanent collection, and beautifully designed seasonal gardens, Dixon offers a unique cultural experience for visitors of all ages. Explore current art exhibitions in Memphis, attend upcoming museum events and programs, or plan your visit to experience one of the most distinctive museums in the region.
